$comment: schemas/mpy-coverage.schema.json - MPY introspection coverage ledger. Governs docs/concepts/MPY-COVERAGE-MATRIX.json. Hand-authored per MPY-01 §5.1; the ledger is a claim ledger, NOT a descriptor catalog (INV-MPY-01-6). Adding a coverage status or MPY-I level requires an MPY-01 amendment (Specification Required, MPY-01 §3 / MPY-00 §7.1).
title: MPY Introspection Coverage Ledger

schema_version.description: Ledger schema version. Bumping requires an MPY-01 §15 amendment.

lvgl_baseline.description: Inherited LPAR-01 §2 pin. INV-MPY-01-1: MPY MUST NOT advance this independently.

rows.description: MPY Coverage Rows. One row is the entire claim unit (MPY-01 §5); crate-wide or release-wide statements are forbidden by INV-MPY-01-5.

level.description: Introspection parity level. Frozen by Standards Action in MPY-00 §7.1.

status.description: Coverage status. Frozen by Specification Required in MPY-01 §3.

profile.description: Evidence target profile. MPY-01 §8 requires evidence to be recorded separately per profile; a report MUST NOT collapse profiles to the best result.

evidence.description: One deterministic evidence artifact. MPY-01 §8: every row promoted to `current` cites at least one deterministic test plus the relevant public documentation.

ref.description: Path, test name, or artifact id. Must be resolvable from the repository root.

claim.description: A per-profile status claim with its evidence.

unsupported_reason.description: Required when status is `unsupported`. INV-MPY-01-3: an unsupported row MUST name the rejecting capability or profile.

reopen_trigger.description: Required when status is `deferred`. MPY-01 §3 requires a named reopen trigger.

id.description: Stable row id. Never re-bound: a retired row keeps its id.

surface.description: Actor type or runtime surface this row claims.

reference.description: Reference LVGL symbols, or an explicit rlvgl-adjacent label when no upstream symbol governs.

required_behavior.description: The semantic behavior the row requires, independent of implementation.

baseline_status.description: The MPY-01 §6 frozen classification at ratification. Historical; later phases add per-profile claims rather than editing this.

baseline_note.description: Why the baseline classification is what it is.

claims.description: Per-profile evidence-backed claims. Empty at baseline: MPY-01 freezes row scope and status, and later phases update status only with cited evidence (MPY-01 §6).

differences.description: Intentional differences from the reference, or unsupported markers.
